subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia drank in the chamber, reading the room before anything else.
source_quote: I drank it in. That is the job, before anything else: read the room.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia believes the bronze everywhere had been untouched for a long time, or nobody dares.
source_quote: Bronze everywhere, all of it gone to verdigris, that green crust that says nobody has touched this in a long time, or nobody dares.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia tried to break down the west door twice and failed.
source_quote: I set myself, and I hit it. It didn't give. I bounced... I set again and hit it a second time, everything I had... and it threw me again.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia realized the door had shuddered and alerted the men inside.
source_quote: Behind the door, the two men went still, then loud. They'd felt it — the door shuddering, something heavy throwing itself at them twice and not getting through.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr listened at the west door before attempting to enter.
source_quote: He put his ear to the door first, the way you do, listening for the thing on the other side before you give it a reason to listen back.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr lied about being messengers for Kelno to gain entry.
source_quote: We were messengers, then — bearing word of an assassination, a letter, a coin to prove it. Zinnia produced the proof.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr killed the second cultist with a blade to the expected spot.
source_quote: The second was mine. Surprise, for an assassin, is not an advantage. It is a sentence already finished before the man knows it started. The blade went in where it always goes. Automatic. Done.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr respects Kelno as an honest man with a poisoned knife and a grudge.
source_quote: An honest man with a poisoned knife and a grudge. I respected all three.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr drove Kelno's Dagger of Venom into Belsornig’s ribs.
source_quote: I crossed the last step, found the soft place under the ribs, and drove Kelno's gift home.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr heard the gong ring after Belsornig’s death and recognized it as the temple announcing a change of hands.
source_quote: And a gong rang. Deep, enormous, rolling out through the whole second level. *Are they opening the door?* I asked, dagger still warm in my fist — but it wasn't a door. It was the temple announcing that something had changed hands.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr lied to the bugbears that the cleric was hurt but would be fine.
source_quote: He's hurt. He will be fine.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr accepted the bugbears' order to be summoned, not to summon.
source_quote: They looked past me, counting heads. 'Where is the cleric?' 'I will summon him.' 'The cleric is in charge, of course.' 'Yes,' I said, and the useful lie settled into place the way it always does.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr offered meat to the bugbears to disrupt their certainty.
source_quote: Then Zephyr offered them meat. 'Are you hungry? Would you like some meat?'

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia realizes the Greater Temple had forces on this level all along, hidden in plain sight.
source_quote: I knew. The Greater Temple had not kept its forces below. They had forces on this level, in the parts of the map we had never walked, sitting quiet behind brown marble while we ran our little war for them floor by floor.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia noticed he had failed to see the hidden Greater Temple forces.
source_quote: *Gotcha.* Except this time the catch was on me. I had not seen them, and I am the one who sees. That stayed with me.

subject: Barkinar
fact: Barkinar acknowledged the deaths of Romag, Hartsch, Alrrem, and Belsornig as completed problems.
source_quote: Romag. Hartsch. Alrrem. Belsornig," Barkinar said. "Problems I had on a list yesterday morning, and four problems gone by sundown.

subject: Barkinar
fact: Barkinar considers Senshock ambitious and paranoid but useful.
source_quote: Senshock — our Lord Wizard — has opinions about new arrivals. He is ambitious and paranoid. He is also useful.

subject: Barkinar
fact: Barkinar instructed Zephyr and Zinnia to organize the Upper Temple within a week.
source_quote: A week to organize the house. The house we came to burn.

subject: Barkinar
fact: Barkinar smiled at Kelno, revealing he had been watching him for two weeks.
source_quote: Beside me they set Kelno, and Barkinar looked at him and smiled. I filed that. A man who smiles at the prisoner he has been watching from hidden passages for two weeks is a man who already knows more than he is saying.

subject: Falrinth
fact: Falrinth is a wizard hiding from the Greater Temple for reasons of his own, but the details are not yet revealed.
source_quote: A second name, set down lighter, for later: Falrinth, a wizard hiding from the Greater Temple for reasons of his own. 'We could talk about Falrinth later.'

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia remained silent when Barkinar spoke, recognizing silence as the only honest thing in the room.
source_quote: I said nothing. Silence has never cost me anything, and it was the only honest thing in the room.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr accepted the role of new ruler of the Upper Temple, despite having come to burn it.
source_quote: We came here to take this temple apart. We had become it instead.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia realized the bugbears had converged from three directions, revealing they had always been watching.
source_quote: They came from the secret door we had left barred. They came from the eastern door. They came from the western door. Three approaches, converged at once, and the converging was the message: *we were always here, on every side of you, and you did not know.*

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr recognized the voice from the stairs as someone who knew the room and what happened in it.
source_quote: A voice came up from the stairs leading down. Unhurried. The voice of someone who had been in this room before and knew what happened in it.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr was called 'puppet master' by the voice from the stairs.
source_quote: Puppet master. So they had watched the strings too, and named the hand that pulled them.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr agreed to meet Barkinar, accepting the new power structure.
source_quote: We went down.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia saw Kelno set beside him and filed Barkinar’s smile as significant.
source_quote: Beside me they set Kelno, and Barkinar looked at him and smiled. I filed that.
